title: Anderdingus
blurb: Some names are too stupid to be real and too funny to forget. Anderdingus belongs firmly in the second category. It sits in the same absurdist family as Quandale Dingle, a whole cast of characters who exist for no reason beyond the way their names sit in the mouth, with backstories assembled retroactively by people who found the sound funny first and worried about meaning later. That is a genuinely old comic tradition wearing very new clothes. Play it as a greeting, an insult, or an introduction for somebody who has earned neither.
origin: A goofy-ahh-genre character name in the Quandale Dingle tradition.
